row_grain: one row per mapped Microsoft MDX source surface

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_key_concepts
rows.notes: Defines measures, dimensions, dimension attributes, members, attribute hierarchies, navigation hierarchies, all/leaf/parent members, and precomputed aggregations.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_query_fundamentals
rows.notes: Maps MDX query documentation for cellsets, query/slicer axes, cube context, named sets, calculated members, cell calculations, properties, data manipulation, writeback, variables, and parameters.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_basic_query
rows.notes: Covers MDX SELECT axes, sets of members/tuples, FROM cube context, WHERE slicer axis, SELECT/FROM/WHERE syntax, and SQL contrast.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_members_tuples_sets
rows.notes: Covers member, tuple, set, array, hierarchy, level, logical, numeric, and string function concepts.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_syntax_elements
rows.notes: Covers identifiers, data types, expressions, operators, functions, comments, reserved keywords, members, tuples, and sets.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_expressions
rows.notes: Covers constants, scalar functions, object identifiers, complex expressions, expression results, calculated measures, and cube/dimension/member/tuple/set/scalar expressions.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_select_statement
rows.notes: Covers WITH clauses, query axes, subcubes, slicer axes, cell/dimension/member properties, NON EMPTY, NON VISUAL, calculated members in subselects, and Autoexists.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_function_reference
rows.notes: Function-family index for array, hierarchy, level, logical, member, numeric, set, string, and tuple functions.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_calculated_members
rows.notes: Covers calculated members, hierarchy placement, query-scoped WITH members, session-scoped CREATE MEMBER, and calculated-member dependencies.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_named_sets
rows.notes: Covers named sets, aliases for set expressions, query-scoped WITH sets, and session-scoped CREATE SET.

rows.title: microsoft_mdx_adventure_works_samples_boundary
rows.notes: Adventure Works sample databases, screenshots, UI captures, MDX examples, downloads, and tutorial assets remain boundary-checked before extraction or caching.
